tables.caption: Transimpedance-loop stability across the electrode grid at the typical statistical process point (\SI{37}{\celsius}, zero statistical offset). Randles electrode, $R_u = R_{\mathrm{ce}} = \SI{1}{\kilo\ohm}$ fixed, $C_{\mathrm{dl}}$ and $R_{\mathrm{ct}}$ swept over the twelve $R_f\times C_{\mathrm{dl}}\times R_{\mathrm{ct}}$ combinations simulated (rows grouped by $R_f$). Phase margin stays inside \SIrange{89.3}{93.3}{\degree} over all twelve cells and all five process corners of this grid (verified from the same extracted data, not tabulated in full here for width) -- the transimpedance loop needs no explicit compensation capacitor $C_F$ across the electrode range simulated.

System output and input-referred noise across the electrode grid, conditions and process point as Table~\ref{tab:px-grid-pm}. Output noise integrated \SIrange{0.1}{1000}{\hertz}; input-referred current noise is the same integral divided by $R_f$ and is therefore not comparable across the two $R_f$ blocks by itself. At $R_f = \SI{560}{\kilo\ohm}$ noise grows with $C_{\mathrm{dl}}$, not $R_{\mathrm{ct}}$: the closed-loop noise gain is $e_n\cdot(1+R_f/Z_{\mathrm{electrode}})$ and $|Z_{\mathrm{electrode}}|$ falls with $C_{\mathrm{dl}}$ over the \SIrange{0.1}{1}{\kilo\hertz} integration band, which the standalone TIA bench of Section~\ref{sss:ampab-tia} (ideal $R_f$, no electrode network) cannot show.

_note: Companion config for the Pixel section's stability-grid part. Contributes
tab_px_grid_pm only (fig_px_grid_pm/tab_px_grid_noise etc. come from the
sibling anatop_tb_pixel_grid_noise.json). Named in Pixel's own `order`.

1-60: PotTiaTB stb+noise over 12 electrode-grid cells (cdl_we in
{100n,1u,10u} x rf in {35k,560k} x rct_we in {10k,1M}, nested in that order

TABLE DESIGN: bycorner with corner_match implicit via an explicit `corners`
list of the 12 nominal-temperature (37 C, zero offset) points -- the first
point of each 5-corner group of Interactive.20's grid (1,6,11,...,56), which
fall back to label ptN (no cor_std_mos.scs at the statistical point). This is
the NOMINAL-CORNER slice of the grid; the full 60-point (12 cell x 5 corner)
PM/vn_out range is stated in the table caption and in note_pixel_grid.tex,
verified by inspecting every one of the 60 extracted CSVs (see
note_pixel_grid.tex header) rather than tabulated in full -- a 60-row table
would not fit the page and the AmpAB/TiaAmpAB precedent already establishes
that a grid's full range belongs in prose once verified from the committed
data/raw CSVs. sortvar=cdl_we only orders the 12 rows by double-layer
capacitance; rf and rct_we ride along as ordinary signal columns
(grid_rf/grid_rct) so the full grid identity of each row is visible without
a second table.
